يتغيّر سعر الذهب عالمياً بشكل شبه مستمر،: The global gold price changes almost continuously, because it is priced in US dollars in global markets affected by factors such as the strength of the dollar, inflation expectations and interest rates, central banks buying gold as a reserve, and geopolitical events that push investors towards safe assets. The price you see here is a direct reflection of that global price converted into the local currency.
عيار 24 هو الذهب الخالص، بينما الأعيرة ا: 24K is pure gold, while lower karats (22, 21, 18) are mixed with other metals to add hardness and withstand daily wear — the lower the karat, the lower the actual gold content and the more durable the piece. When buying, compare the making charge between several shops (it varies a lot and sometimes affects the final price more than the gold price itself), always ask for an invoice stating the karat and the weight of the piece, and if your goal is investment, 24K bars and coins are better than jewellery because you don't lose the making charge when reselling.
